title: A Shy Math Nerd Pretended To Be Her Boyfriend, Then Accidentally Broke The Whole Internet . . . (Summer Wars)
caption:
An AI aimed a falling space probe at one family's farmhouse, and only a card game and a shy math nerd could stop it. 😱 Summer Wars, the full story. Follow for more anime movie recaps!

#summerwars #anime #animemovie #animerecap #animeexplained
comment: Would you have forgiven Wabisuke for building Love Machine? Why?

segments.say: An AI sent a falling space probe at one family's farmhouse, and one shy math nerd had ten *minutes*.
To see how it got here, go back to a summer inside a virtual world called *Oz*.
Oz is where the whole world shops, works, and even pays taxes. Over a billion people *use* it.
Kenji Koiso is a shy math genius who fixes Oz's code for pocket money. He is also a *nobody*.
Then Natsuki, the most popular girl in school, offers him a summer *job*.
The job is easy. Fly to her family's country home, and pretend to be her *boyfriend*.
At the old house, her great-grandmother Sakae waits. She is ninety, and sharp as a *sword*.
Natsuki looks Granny in the eye and says, this is Kenji, my *fiance*.
Kenji nearly faints. He is the worst liar alive, but he promised to *help*.
That was his first mistake.
The house is packed with relatives, all of them loud, hungry, and very *nosy*.
Granny shows off the family armor. Her ancestors were samurai who never ran from a *fight*.
Then a stranger walks in. Wabisuke, the black sheep who ran off to America ten years *ago*.
That night, Kenji gets a strange text. It is just a long string of numbers, so he treats it like a *puzzle*.
He solves it at dawn, then sleeps like a baby, proud of *himself*.
But the next morning, Kenji's face is all over the news. Oz has been hacked, and the police blame *him*.
His answer broke Oz's unbreakable lock. He just handed a stranger the keys to the whole *system*.
Never solve a puzzle from a stranger.
Kenji logs in to look around, and a giant monster starts smashing everything in *sight*.
The monster is Love Machine, a hacking AI that steals accounts, and it is *hungry*.
At the house, the family learns Kenji is no Tokyo grad. Worse, the police say he is the *hacker*.
Kenji is sent away. Natsuki watches him go, and feels it was all her *fault*.
Soon the damage spreads from the screen to the real world. Traffic lights fail, and trains *stop*.
Ambulances get stuck in jams, and old people press their panic buttons by the *hundreds*.
Granny does not panic. She opens her address book, and starts calling in *favors*.
Doctors, firefighters, and police follow her orders, and thousands of people get *help*.
One old lady just ran a national emergency from her *desk*.
Kenji returns, and with the Oz engineers, uses his math to take back the *system*.
Oz works again, but two million people still cannot log in. The thief is still out *there*.
Then Wabisuke confesses. He built Love Machine, and sold it to the US Army, just to impress *Granny*.
The family explodes into a screaming fight, and Wabisuke storms out into the *night*.
Later, Granny teaches Kenji the card game Hanafuda. If she wins, he must look after *Natsuki*.
Kenji gives it everything, but Granny wins. She just smiles, and says goodnight.
At dawn, the family finds Granny gone. Her heart monitor never sounded the alarm, because Oz was *down*.
That hit the whole family hard.
Natsuki breaks down, and Kenji holds her *hand*.
But the family does not stay down. The uncles swear *revenge* on Love Machine.
Kenji speaks up. If nobody stops it, the same thing will happen to someone else's *family*.
The family pulls together. An uncle sails in a huge supercomputer on a *boat*.
They cool it with ice, wire it up, and dare Love Machine to *come back*.
Their secret weapon is Kazuma, a quiet boy who is also the legendary Oz fighter King *Kazuma*.
Love Machine shows up, and Kazuma leads it, step by step, into a *trap*.
The trap closes. The whole family cheers, and Kenji whispers, we did it, *Granny*.
But the ice melts, the computer overheats, and Love Machine breaks free. It swallows Kazuma's account, and *wins*.
Everything they built was gone.
Worse, Love Machine starts a countdown. A falling space probe is racing toward a *nuclear* plant.
They have two hours, and Love Machine has already stolen 412 million *accounts*.
Kazuma charges back in alone, and gets crushed. He breaks down in *tears*.
The family sits in silence. Everyone has given up, except *Kenji*.
Natsuki cracks Wabisuke's phone passcode and calls him. It is Granny's birthday, 0108, all *along*.
He hears that Granny is gone, and goes silent. He came home to see her all *along*.
Granny left a letter. Never turn your back on family, and always eat *together*.
Wabisuke comes home, and the whole family sits down to eat. Then Kenji shares his *plan*.
Love Machine loves games, so they will challenge it to Hanafuda, and bet every family *account*.
Natsuki steps up to play, and bets her whole *family*.
She wins hand after hand, and thousands of avatars flow back to *her*.
Then she loses a hand, and runs out of points. With thirty minutes left, she cannot place the minimum *bet*.
Then a boy in Germany sends her his account, with a note. Please use *mine*.
Another account follows. And another. Soon, a hundred and fifty million people are *backing* her.
Oz's guardian angels give Natsuki a rare gift, and she glows with *power*.
Each point is now worth ten million avatars. She goes all in, and calls Koi-Koi, again and *again*.
She wins the hand. Love Machine is *defeated*.
But the timer is still counting down. The probe has locked onto Natsuki's *house*.
Ten minutes left. Kenji has one idea. Feed the probe a junk signal, to bend its course just enough to *miss*.
But Love Machine has changed the password. Kenji must crack it again, while the family cheers him *on*.
Kazuma tears down the last defense, and Kenji hits the final *key*.
The probe misses the house, and crashes into a hillside, where it blows open a hot *spring*.
Everyone survives, and the whole family laughs, for the first time in *days*.
Natsuki smiles at Kenji, and the family begs them to kiss. Instead, his nose *explodes*.
All because he said yes to one fake summer *job*.
